Single-line text entry (Eeva V1 board 3b). 32px, radius 8, white with a 12% ring at rest, 20% on hover, an ink ring and halo while editing.

**Use:** A short string in a row or small form: Requester, Topic, Goal.

**Avoid:** No disabled state: a read-only value renders as plain text. A link is `UrlField`.

**Variants:** error

## Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `error` | `boolean` | no |  |
